# oe_eln.1 — First Convocation of the Senatus Novae Elysiae (+2 years)
# ==============================================================================
oe_eln.1 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_eln.1.title
	desc = oe_eln.1.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_eln_senatus_hesperiae.dds"

	trigger = {
		oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_eln_ensure_init = yes
		set_variable = { name = oe_eln_senate_convened value = 1 }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.1.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.1.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		oe_eln_shift_senate_axis = { delta = -35 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae } }
			add_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae
		}
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_basileus_hesperiae
		add_legitimacy = 10
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:nobles_estate value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.1.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.1.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		oe_eln_shift_senate_axis = { delta = 35 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae } }
			add_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae
		}
		add_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_res_publica_elysia
		add_stability = 5
		add_estate_satisfaction = { type = estate_type:burghers_estate value = estate_satisfaction_mild_bonus }
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.1.c
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.1.c.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 30 }
		oe_eln_shift_senate_axis = { delta = 5 }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae } }
			add_reform = government_reform:oe_eln_ref_senatus_novae_elysiae
		}
		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_polybian_balance
			years = 20
			mode = replace
		}
		culture = {
			add_cultural_tradition = 5
		}
	}
}

		add_country_modifier = {
			modifier = oe_eln_mod_blue_ridge_bastions
			years = 25
			mode = replace
		}
		every_owned_location = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					area = area:virginia_area
					area = area:maryland_area
				}
			}
			add_location_modifier = {
				modifier = oe_eln_limes_march_loc_mod
				years = 25
				mode = replace
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:IRO }
			c:IRO = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = border_aggression } }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:STD c:STD = { country_type = pop } }
				c:STD = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = border_aggression } }
			}
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:OSG c:OSG = { country_type = pop } }
				c:OSG = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = border_aggression } }
			}
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.15.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.15.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 40 }
		add_gold = -40
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:IRO }
			c:IRO = { add_opinion = { target = root modifier = moderate_treaty } }
			add_truce_with = { target = c:IRO years = 10 mutual = yes }
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { country_exists = c:STD c:STD = { country_type = pop } }

# oe_eln.17 — Nea Athenai at the Mouth of the Hudson (Manhattan Expansion)
# ==============================================================================
oe_eln.17 = {
	type = country_event
	title = oe_eln.17.title
	desc = oe_eln.17.desc
	outcome = positive
	image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/events/oe_ev_maritime_silk_road.dds"

	trigger = {
		oe_eln_is_elysia = yes
		oe_eln_has_northern_hub = yes
	}

	immediate = {
		oe_eln_ensure_init = yes
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.17.a
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.17.a.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 65 }
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_host
		add_gold = -60
		location:manhattan = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
				rename_location = oe_loc_nea_athenai
				if = {
					limit = {
						NOR = {
							location_rank = location_rank:city
							location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
						}
					}
					change_location_rank = location_rank:city
				}
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_eln_nea_athenai_port_loc_mod
					years = 30
					mode = replace
				}
				add_pop = {
					culture = scope:oe_eln_host.culture
					religion = scope:oe_eln_host.religion
					type = pop_type:burghers
					size = 0.35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { country_exists = c:MNS c:MNS = { country_type = pop } }
			c:MNS = { add_opinion = { target = scope:oe_eln_host modifier = opinion_peaceful_trade_relations } }
		}
	}

	option = {
		name = oe_eln.17.b
		custom_tooltip = oe_eln.17.b.tt
		ai_chance = { base = 35 }
		save_temporary_scope_as = oe_eln_host
		add_navy_tradition = 6
		location:manhattan = {
			if = {
				limit = { has_owner = yes owner = scope:oe_eln_host }
				rename_location = oe_loc_nea_athenai
				add_location_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_eln_northern_fleet_base_loc_mod
					years = 25
					mode = replace

			}
